description: Agreement drift over a run, and whether a co-evolving judge drives more of it than a frozen one. Corpus: experiments/spread_util_unified.json.

decay_difference_at_round4.note: negative difference means round-1 agreement predicts later agreement LESS well when the judge co-evolves

conventions.zero_spread_rounds: agreement recorded as 0 when every candidate scores the same; kept rather than dropped, because collapsed pools are the behaviour under study, and counted per run
